args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was actually implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Change
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

2. **Fixed it on a new branch** `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`: changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).

transcript.content: The test confirms it: the docstring says ROUND_HALF_EVEN (per FIN-212), but the code uses ROUND_HALF_UP. Let me fix it on a new branch.
transcript.reasoning_content: Note: 2.675 in binary float is 2.67499... but with Decimal it's exact, so ROUND_HALF_EVEN gives 2.68 (since 2.675 → half, last digit 7 odd → rounds to 8). 2.665 → 2.66. So fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
